ANIMAL HUSBANDRY
Keeping Horses
Although the horse  is  insensitive to wind (and  has  a physiologi-
cal need  of  air movement), draughts should be prevented. This is 
done with artificial ventilation systems providing constant airflow. 
There  is  little point  in  attempting  an  'ideal' stable temperature. 
With sufficient preparation and appropriate management, any 
horse can tolerate winter temperatures  in  the stable, even a few 
degrees  of  frost"""  e.
